_doc: Ranked prebuild targets for `hctf prebuild --lane metadata-forensics` (first not-done target first). A target is done when every (fmt, field) is registered in lib.meta; one that failed the gate HCTF_PREBUILD_MAX_ATTEMPTS times is skipped (.run/prebuild-state.json). Ranking = likelihood of being tomorrow's question (D9-D13 walked PE -> PE version -> .NET -> MSI: Windows binaries/installers first) x cost.

targets.goal: MSI siblings of the D13 ProductCode: SummaryInformation stream (\x05SummaryInformation property set: PID_REVNUMBER 9 = PackageCode GUID text, PID_TITLE 2, PID_AUTHOR 4, PID_TEMPLATE 7 'Intel;1033') plus Property-table values. product_version/upgrade_code_guid exist as speculative built-ins (lib/meta/msi.py): only add fixtures-backed NEW fields; do not re-register those keys.

COFF/optional-header fields of PE files: TimeDateStamp, NumberOfSections, Subsystem, Characteristics, DllCharacteristics, SizeOfImage, CheckSum, section names in table order (JSON list). pe.image_base_hex / optional_header_magic exist (speculative built-ins).

VS_VERSIONINFO: pe.version_* string keys are covered by the speculative family pe.version_* (lib/meta/pe.py); the NEW work is the VS_FIXEDFILEINFO binary dwFileVersionMS/LS rendered a.b.c.d as `fixed_file_version` (+ `fixed_product_version`, dwFileFlags, dwFileOS); include fixtures whose StringFileInfo FileVersion differs from the fixed one (the classic decoy).

.NET metadata: Assembly table row (Name, Version a.b.c.d, Culture), Module name, metadata root version string (BSJB, e.g. v4.0.30319), public key token, TypeDef row count. Reuse lib/meta/dotnet.py's parser (import it; do not edit it).
Microsoft Cabinet (MSCF): CFHEADER cFolders/cFiles/setID/cbCabinet/versionMajor.Minor, CFFILE names in order.
Windows shortcut (MS-SHLLINK): header LinkFlags/FileAttributes/times/FileSize, LinkInfo local base path, StringData (working dir, arguments), TrackerDataBlock machine id.
Windows Event Log (ElfFile header + first ElfChnk): chunk count, next record id, first record id, version.
Registry hive (regf base block + root nk cell).
OLE2/CFB SummaryInformation property set of legacy Office (.doc/.xls/.ppt) files; stream names. Reuse lib/meta/cfb.py (cfb_streams(b, demangle=False)).
ELF header + PT_INTERP + .note.gnu.build-id. elf.e_machine_u16_hex / e_entry_hex exist (speculative built-ins).

Small image/audio headers: GIF (87a/89a, logical screen WxH, frames); also add bmp.dib_dimensions_pixels / bmp.bits_per_pixel, ico.image_count, wav.fmt_sample_rate / wav.fmt_channels in their own modules.

gzip header (FNAME, MTIME, OS, ISIZE trailer); also tar.member_names / tar.ustar_magic, 7z.signature_version, rar.version, iso.primary_volume_id in their own modules (headers only; no decompression of large payloads).
PNG ancillary chunks: tEXt/iTXt/zTXt key=value, tIME as ISO-8601, chunk order list, IHDR bit depth/colour type. png.ihdr_dimensions_pixels is GM-verified (D5): do not touch it.
JPEG APP1 EXIF IFD0/ExifIFD/GPS tags (pure-Python TIFF walker), APPn segment list. jpeg.sof_dimensions_pixels is GM-verified (D4): do not touch it.
PDF /Info dictionary, page count, catalog /Version, %%EOF count (incremental updates), /Encrypt presence. pdf.header_version is GM-verified (D6): do not touch it.
